parts.text:
The Krebs cycle was named after the biochemist Sir Hans Krebs, who worked out the sequence in 1937.

Fig. 1.1 is an outline of the Krebs cycle.

{{figure:figure_1_1.png}}

Identify substances P-U.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Describe how ATP is produced from ADP in the Krebs cycle.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Describe **and** explain the features of ATP that make it suitable as the universal energy currency.
